_comment: ADDED IN THE PORT, not from the source prototype, which had one difficulty. The run is sixteen knocks and three nights, and once you have finished it there is nothing further to reach for — which is the shortage every roguelike solves the same way. LEVELS ARE CUMULATIVE: level 3 applies its own line and every line below it. `unlock_at` is how many runs must have been FINISHED (won or lost, the same measure Profile keeps) before a level may be chosen; level 0 is always available. The fx keys are read by Run.gd: `max_mul` multiplies how much composure every caller has to be moved (the one key every encounter feels, since a wall only exists for the two signs that raise one — measured, `denial_add` alone moved the whole field by 0.2 points and Taurus by ten), `denial_add` thickens every sitter's wall, `turns_sub` takes a reading off every encounter, `coin_sub` starts you poorer, `elite_chance` replaces the 0.55 roll that decides whether the second caller of an hour is difficult, and `hand_sub` deals you one card fewer. Marked `"added": "port"` so the game's author can find and replace the whole ladder in one search.

difficulty.name: AN ORDINARY WEEK
difficulty.text: The village as it is. Three nights, sixteen knocks, whoever turns up.

difficulty.name: WORD HAS GOT ROUND
difficulty.text: They arrive having already decided what you are going to say. Everyone takes a tenth more moving, and every denial wall is two thicker.

difficulty.name: A HARD WINTER
difficulty.text: Nobody has anything spare. You start with four centimes fewer.

difficulty.name: THEY COME LATE
difficulty.text: Every one of them arrives with less of the evening left. One reading fewer, with everybody.

difficulty.name: THE DIFFICULT ONES
difficulty.text: The village sends you the ones nobody else will sit with. Far more of them are difficult.

difficulty.name: YOU ARE TIRED
difficulty.text: You have been doing this for eleven years and it is starting to show. One card fewer in hand.
